task_name: Check and Report MSFT Stock Price
summary: Use a browser to retrieve the latest available Microsoft (MSFT) stock quote from a reliable financial source and report the price with relevant timing information.
required_inputs: Access to a financial market data website

1.step_description: Open a browser and navigate to a reliable financial market data website.

exemplars.action: I will open a browser and navigate to Nasdaq’s Microsoft stock page at https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/msft.

2.step_description: Search for the MSFT ticker and open the Microsoft stock quote page.

exemplars.action: Search for “MSFT stock,” then open the Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT) stock quote page from the search results.

3.step_description: Record the displayed stock price, currency, timestamp, and whether the market is open or closed.

exemplars.action: I will record the displayed MSFT stock price, its currency, the quote timestamp, and whether the market is shown as open or closed.

4.step_description: Report the MSFT price clearly, including the quote timestamp and source.

exemplars.action: I will report MSFT’s latest quoted stock price, clearly stating the currency, exact quote timestamp and time zone, and the market-data source.
